description: Client-subsystem test: phase-rs/phase#5184 (open, unmerged fix PR) — loadPresets crashes on corrupt preset storage. Real loadPresets/savePreset/deletePreset from current mainline vs the PR-head bytes, driven by the PR's own vitest block in headless node (no DOM involvement beyond happy-dom localStorage). Corroboration + ledger-repair run: the 2026-09-10 run (20260909-5184) reached the same verdict on the same mainline commit; this run re-verified that evidence and re-ran the contract.
driver_notes: Ledger-repair + corroboration: 2026-09-10 run 20260909-5184 validated as reproduced on mainline aa1fb24 and published (evidence commit b3fee804b4d7..., maintained comment 5610957892); only the ledger entry was lost. All 4 prior-run evidence files re-downloaded from commit-pinned raw URLs and verified (hashes match manifest, JSON parses, PNG readable); comment re-fetched (marker + verdict + links present).
Same mainline commit aa1fb24 for both runs — this corroboration is on identical bytes.
PR variant under test is the literal PR-head file content (byte-verified against the GitHub contents API), not a patch approximation.

The PR-variant targeted run with default coverage settings exits 1 on the repo-wide coverage threshold gate despite 4/4 tests passing; the evidence log uses --coverage.enabled=false (EXIT=0). Config artifact, not a test failure.
Driver test presets-5184.driver.test.ts is content-equivalent to the PR's presets.test.ts (identical test bodies; only the describe/it names and header comment differ).

Full services/__tests__ suite on both trees: the only deltas are the 2 driver-test failures on mainline (the bug); the other 12 failures (scryfall.test.ts) and the 2 ENOENT checkout-artifact failures (serverDirectory/serverMetrics) are identical on both trees.
limitations: Client-subsystem test only: no engine game session (the defect is a pure client JSON.parse crash); whether corrupt storage occurs in production (interrupted mid-flush write, older schema) was not simulated beyond malformed strings.
Only the load/save/delete preset path exercised; the game-setup preset UI itself (DOM) was not driven — the crash is in the service layer the UI calls.
The client/ subtree copies in client-test/ lack lobby-worker/, so serverDirectory/serverMetrics tests fail with ENOENT there; unrelated to this change and identical on both trees.
Not a fix claim for the repo: the PR remains open and unmerged; review deferred by maintainer intake policy.

release_check.note: Latest stable engine release v0.84.0 matches the pinned release; no advancement. phase-server not started for this client-only run.

result: reproduced on current mainline (aa1fb24): loadPresets() with corrupt storage throws SyntaxError (Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 for "{oops"), and savePreset()/deletePreset() throw through the same path (Unexpected token 'o', "not json" is not valid JSON). Controls pass: empty storage returns the 2 defaults, valid storage round-trips. On the PR variant (literal PR-head bytes), all 4 PR tests pass — corrupt storage falls back to DEFAULT_PRESETS, no throws, controls green. Full services/__tests__ suite: identical pre-existing failures on both trees (scryfall.test.ts x12, ENOENT checkout artifacts x2); zero presets regressions from the fix.
scope: phase-rs/phase#5184 (open, unmerged PR by jeffrey701): wrap loadPresets' JSON.parse in try/catch and fall back to DEFAULT_PRESETS. Real loadPresets/savePreset/deletePreset from mainline aa1fb24 vs the PR's head bytes, driven by the PR's own new vitest block (4 cases) in headless node; repo-pinned vitest 4.1.0, happy-dom localStorage; no engine session involved.
